_note: Each value carries a confidence tag. 'assumption' and 'simulated' values are ours and must stay visible in the app. Sources are in RESEARCH.md sections 2, 4, 6 and 8.

range_mi.note: Widely reported range including reserves; not published by the maker

launch_delay_min_median.note: Call to lift-off at the aircraft's base. Helicopter programs report about 13 min

load_min_median.note: Time at the sending hospital. No air taxi data exists, so this is the helicopter air ambulance figure (RESEARCH.md section 12)

unload_min_median.note: Landing to handover at the receiving hospital. Helicopter figure, direct helipad (RESEARCH.md section 12)

reserve_min.note: FAA powered-lift rule, vertical landing capable

battery_kwh.note: Unofficial analysis; some say up to 200

usable_fraction.note: Share of the pack that may be used

hover_min_per_leg.note: Take-off plus landing, per flight leg

cruise_kwh_per_mi.note: Chosen so a full pack gives about the reported 100 mile range including the reserve

heat_loss_per_c_above_25.note: Usable energy lost per degree C above 25, capped at 22% (a simulation reported up to 22% seasonal range loss)

wind_aloft_factor.note: Wind at cruise height compared with the airport's surface wind

start_charge_min.note: Battery charge at dispatch is drawn between this and full

pad_available_p.note: Chance both landing pads are free; no real pad data exists

launch_delay_min_median.note: Mean dispatch to lift-off on interfacility flights, one Colorado program (Clark 2019, abstract only). Montana reports a 9 min median

load_min_median.note: Mean time on the ground at the sending hospital (Svenson 2006, Wisconsin; Leicht 1986 agrees; abstracts only). Sources range from 8 to about 42 min by definition

unload_min_median.note: Mean landing to handover with a direct helipad, German interhospital missions (PMC10598984)

avg_mph.note: Used only when no routed time is available

detour_factor.note: Road miles per straight-line mile, used only when no routed distance is available

dispatch_delay_min_median.note: Median ambulance request to arrival at the sending hospital, Chicago stroke transfers (Prabhakaran 2021, abstract only)

load_min_median.note: Median ambulance time at the sending hospital, same study. A Dutch stroke study reports 15 min from notification to departure, so US and European figures differ a lot

handoff_min_median.note: Arrival to handoff at the receiving hospital; no published figure found

late_start_min_median.note: Extra delay to call an ambulance after an air attempt is called off
